studio.name: Brainstorming Studios
studio.bio: The team behind Brainstorming Games. Our own games are the BS Originals.

games.title: Project Homecoming
games.shortDescription: A deep-space 3D adventure across the solar system: repair your ship, follow an impossible signal and guide the crew home.
games.descriptionMd:
**Project Homecoming** is a 3D space exploration adventure that runs straight in your browser.

Your ship is damaged and a long way from Earth. Repair it, chart a course across the solar system, follow a signal that should not exist, and bring the crew home.

Progress is saved on your device, and to your account when you are logged in.
games.howToPlayMd:
1. Press **Play** and follow the opening story.
2. Explore, repair the ship and follow the on-screen objectives.
3. Your progress saves by itself, so you can come back later.

faq.a: Yes. Progress is saved on this device, and to your Brainstorming account if you are logged in.
Yes, in landscape. A recent phone or a computer gives the smoothest picture.

faq.q: Can I change the graphics quality?
faq.a: Yes. The in-game settings have graphics options for slower devices.

games.title: Brain Pairs
games.shortDescription: Flip the cards and find all eight pairs in as few moves as you can.
games.descriptionMd: **Brain Pairs** is a quick memory game. Sixteen cards, eight pairs. Remember where each shape hides and clear the board in as few moves as possible.
games.howToPlayMd:
1. Tap a card to flip it, then a second one.
2. Matching cards stay open.
3. Clear the board. Fewer moves and less time give a higher score.

faq.q: How is the score worked out?
faq.a: You start from 2,000 and lose 40 for every move and 5 for every second.
No. Take as long as you like; faster rounds simply score more.
Yes, your fewest moves are saved.

games.title: Orbit Dodge
games.shortDescription: Circle the core, switch direction with one tap and slip between the sparks.
games.descriptionMd: **Orbit Dodge** is a one-button arcade game. You circle a core that throws out sparks. One tap switches your direction. Collect the yellow dots and last as long as you can while everything speeds up.
games.howToPlayMd:
1. Tap, click or press **Space** to switch direction.
2. Avoid the orange sparks as they cross your orbit.
3. Collect yellow dots: 10 points each.

faq.a: Yes. You move faster and sparks come more often the longer you last.

faq.q: Can I play with one hand?
faq.a: Yes. The whole game is one tap.
Yes. Your score is sent to the game leaderboard when a round ends.

games.title: Sum Sprint
games.shortDescription: Sixty seconds of quick sums. Keep a streak going to score big.
games.descriptionMd: **Sum Sprint** gives you 60 seconds of mental arithmetic. Pick the right answer out of four. Every correct answer in a row is worth more, and a wrong one costs two seconds.
games.howToPlayMd:
1. Read the sum.
2. Tap the right answer, or press **1** to **4**.
3. Build a streak before the bar runs out.

faq.q: What kinds of sums are there?
faq.a: Addition and subtraction first, then multiplication as your score grows.

faq.q: What does a wrong answer cost?
faq.a: Two seconds, and your streak goes back to zero.

faq.q: Is it good practice for school?
faq.a: It is quick mental-maths practice, and it works in school-safe mode.

games.title: Last Light
games.shortDescription: Survive 15 minutes against endless monster swarms. Your weapons fire on their own: dodge, level up, evolve and beat the Eclipse.
games.descriptionMd:
**Last Light** is a horde survival game where the screen fills with monsters and you are the last light left.

Your weapons fire on their own, so all you do is move. Every level-up gives you a choice of new weapons and upgrades, and the right pairs **evolve** into something far stronger. A boss arrives every 5 minutes, and at 15:00 the Eclipse comes for you.

Coins you earn stay with you: unlock new heroes and maps, and buy upgrades that last forever.
games.howToPlayMd:
1. Move with **WASD** or the **arrow keys**. On a phone, put your thumb anywhere and drag.
2. Your weapons attack by themselves. Collect the glowing gems to level up.
3. Pick one of three upgrades at every level. Max a weapon and own its partner upgrade to **evolve** it.
4. Survive the bosses at 5:00, 10:00 and 15:00. Beat the Eclipse to win.

faq.a: Get a weapon to level 5 and own its partner upgrade: Pulse Bolt with Twin Shot, Orbit Blades with Swift Boots, Nova Ring with Big Bang, and Chain Spark with Overclock. The evolution then shows up as a gold card.

faq.q: Do I keep anything when I lose?
faq.a: Yes. Coins from every run are saved, and you spend them on new heroes, new maps and upgrades that last forever.

faq.q: Can I come back after dying?
faq.a: Once per run you can watch a short ad to come back with full health.
Yes. Drag anywhere on the screen to move; the game fits any screen shape.
